snippet.title: Abathor - Official Trailer | Mundo Gamer Showcase 2026 - Edition 01
snippet.description:
Can you survive the fall of Atlantis?

Abathor is a challenging 2D action platformer for 1 to 4 players, inspired by classic 16-bit games.

Fight through hordes of monsters, face powerful bosses, and explore a mythological world as you try to close the Gates of Abathor and save Atlantis.

🛒 Add it to your Steam wishlist
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2295610/Abathor/

🍿 About the Game

⚔️ A Classic Action Experience
• Inspired by legendary titles from the 16-bit era
• Fast-paced combat with arcade-style challenge

👥 Solo or Co-op
• Play alone or with up to 4 players locally
• Cooperate and compete for loot and rewards

🐉 Epic Battles
• Face demons, ancient gods, and deadly creatures
• Overcome traps, hazards, and intense boss fights

🗺️ Journey Through Atlantis
• Explore a world inspired by Plato’s writings
• Travel across diverse locations filled with danger

🎮 Game Features
• Over 50 levels with increasing difficulty
• Detailed pixel art and retro aesthetic
• Epic soundtrack with dozens of tracks
